# PTB-XL fixture attribution

The `.hea`/`.dat` files in this directory are a 10-record excerpt from PTB-XL,
distributed under CC BY 4.0:

Wagner, P., Strodthoff, N., Bousseljot, R. et al. PTB-XL, a large publicly available
electrocardiography dataset. Sci Data 7, 154 (2020).
https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-020-0495-6

https://physionet.org/content/ptb-xl/
